articles.title: The best advice young Chicago White Sox players received in their 1st postseason
articles.description: DH Andrew Benintendi was the only player in the Chicago White Sox starting lineup Tuesday with major-league playoff experience. He’s one of the players the young team is leaning on for advice.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox take wild-card series Game 1 with a 6-3 win over the Houston Astros
articles.description: Both bullpens got a workout during the American League wild-card series Game 1, which the Chicago White Sox won 6-3 over the Houston Astros in front of 34,011 at Daikin Park.

articles.description: Chicago White Sox fans persevered through three consecutive 100-loss seasons. Now they’re basking in the postseason.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox set AL wild-card series roster: 12 pitchers, 2 catchers, 5 infielders and 7 outfielders
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox will have 12 pitchers, two catchers, five infielders and seven outfielders available as part of their 26-man roster for the American League wild-card series.

articles.description: The Chicago White Sox can help save baseball from the Houston Astros, a .500 team that can advance with a wild-card series win.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox settle for AL's No. 6 playoff seed after loss
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox’s pursuit of the AL Central title ended Saturday with a 9-6 loss. The Sox are the No. 6 seed and will play at the West winner in a best-of-three wild-card series.

articles.title: How the Chicago White Sox defied history with turnaround
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox have come a long way in two years — going from a record 121 losses in 2024 to qualifying for the playoffs in 2026. Tracing some steps that led to the turnaround.
